_meta.priceConvention: priceCents is integer Australian cents. null = 'ask staff' / variable / not yet confirmed.

notes: 2026-08-03: This file was REBUILT from a live database snapshot. The previous version had drifted badly - it predated ~47 admin edits (owner-uploaded photos, price changes, renames, isFeatured flips) and was missing four products the owner had added. Restoring from the old file would have wiped all of that.

Because every existing product below now carries the exact value it already holds in the live database, the admin 'Restore product listing' button is additive: it creates the new items and rewrites the rest with what they already are.
Keep it that way. Before editing this file again, re-snapshot the live catalogue first - the admin dashboard is the source of truth, not this file.

2026-08: Added the Wraps & Tandoori Deals range (18 items). The 5 kebab wraps and the 3 tandoori chicken portions lead the Savoury category; the 10 combo meals form the new 'Meal' category, which renders first across the site.

Photos for the new range are the shop's own promo posters, converted to webp at /uploads/seed/<slug>.webp. Note the price is printed into the artwork - if a price changes, the photo needs reshooting too.
Quantity (qty) defaults to 1. When qty=1, prices render as '$X/unit' (e.g. '$26/kg'); when qty>1, they render as '$X/<qty><unit>' (e.g. '$7/5pcs', '$24/2kg').
imagePath:null = no photo yet - admin can upload one or the site shows a fallback tile.
imagePath values of the form /uploads/<hash>.webp are owner uploads that live only on the server (public/uploads is gitignored); they will not resolve in local dev.
